title: Saudian Tagine Stew
description: A flavorful vegetarian stew inspired by the rich culinary traditions of Saudi Arabia, made with a rich tagine sauce and served over casserole.
instructions: Heat 2 tbs of oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the saudi spices and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the vegetable broth and bring to a boil.
Add the casserole and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over additional casserole if desired.
